title: Two-Channel Analysis Subband Filter
text: 将信号分解为高频子带和低频子带，输入 1 路、输出 2 路、无直接馈通；按 {Rounding mode} 指定定点运算的舍入模式；{Lowpass FIR filter coefficients}、{Highpass FIR filter coefficients}、{Input processing} 指定输入处理 Columns as channels、{Rate options} 指定速率选项 Enforce single-rate、{Allow arbitrary frame length for fixed-size input signals} 允许固定大小输入信号的任意帧长度、{Saturate on integer overflow} 指定对整数溢出进行饱和、{Coefficients} 指定系数的数据类型、{Coefficients Minimum} 指定滤波器系数的最小值、{Coefficients Maximum} 指定滤波器系数的最大值、{Product output} 指定乘积输出数据类型、{Accumulator} 指定累加器的数据类型、{Output} 输出数据类型、{Output Minimum} 输出最小值、{Output Maximum} 输出最大值、{Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools} 防止定点工具覆盖数据类型，按实例取值。

ports.name: Input 1
ports.summary: 数据输入 column vector | matrix

ports.name: Hi band
ports.summary: 高频子带 column vector | matrix

ports.name: Lo band
ports.summary: 低频子带 column vector | matrix

params.name: Lowpass FIR filter coefficients
params.values: Lowpass FIR filter coefficients [0.0352 -0.0854 -0.1350 0.4599 0.8069 0.3327] (default) | row vector

params.name: Highpass FIR filter coefficients
params.values: Highpass FIR filter coefficients [-0.3327 0.8069 -0.4599 -0.1350 0.0854 0.0352] (default) | row vector

params.name: Input processing
params.values: 输入处理 Columns as channels (frame based) (default) | Elements as channels (sample based)

params.name: Rate options
params.values: 速率选项 Enforce single-rate processing (default) | Allow multirate processing

params.name: Allow arbitrary frame length for fixed-size input signals
params.values: 允许固定大小输入信号的任意帧长度 off (default) | on

params.name: Rounding mode
params.values: 定点运算的舍入模式 Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: 对整数溢出进行饱和 off (default) | on

params.name: Coefficients
params.values: 系数的数据类型 Inherit: Same word length as input (default) | fixdt(1,16) | fixdt(1,16,0)

params.name: Coefficients Minimum
params.values: 滤波器系数的最小值 [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Coefficients Maximum
params.values: 滤波器系数的最大值 [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Product output
params.values: 乘积输出数据类型 Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Same as input | fixdt(1,16,0)

params.name: Accumulator
params.values: 累加器的数据类型 Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Same as input | Inherit: Same as product output | fixdt(1,16,0)

params.name: Output
params.values: 输出数据类型 Inherit: Same as accumulator (default) | Inherit: Same as input | Inherit: Same as product output | fixdt(1,16,0)

params.name: Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: 防止定点工具覆盖数据类型 off (default) | on
